paper_record.title: Colloidal 2D WS2 nanosheets exhibiting high-purity single photon emission
paper_record.abstract: The search for quantum emitters, delivering single photons "on demand" at cryogenic and elevated temperatures for photonic technologies is ever progressing. For example, micrometer-sized WS2 monolayers exhibit single photon emission by elaborated local defect or strain engineering. Here, we show that wet-chemically synthesised monolayered two-dimensional (2D) WS2 nano sheets (NSs) with lateral sizes of 14 (+/- 6 nm) readily emit single photons from exciton recombination without the need for substrate-induced patterning, strain/defect engineering or spectral filtering. Single particle spectroscopy of 70 individual NSs shows photoluminescence from excitons (2.02 eV), trios (1.94 eV) and defect-localized states (1.85 eV) with fast emission (t1<0.2 ns, t2=3.2 ns), allowing highly frequent excitation cycles. Pulsed at 80 MHz, colloidal WS2 NSs exhibit limited spectral diffusion, no blinking and distinct photon antibunching (g2(0)=0.07 at 5 K), thereby tackling challenges of established colloidal quantum dot systems (blinking, longer emission cycles), while retaining high single photon purity as key quality of deterministic quantum emitters.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 湿化学合成的二维硫化钨纳米片在低温下表现出高纯度、无闪烁的单光子发射特性。
one_sentence_summary.en: Wet-chemically synthesized 2D tungsten disulfide nanosheets exhibit high-purity, blinking-free single photon emission at cryogenic temperatures.

problem.zh: 传统二维过渡金属硫属化物需要通过基底图形化、应变或缺陷工程才能实现单光子发射，限制了其在大规模应用中的便利性和可控性。
problem.en: Traditional 2D transition metal dichalcogenides require substrate patterning, strain, or defect engineering to achieve single photon emission, limiting their scalability and convenience.

approach.zh: 采用湿化学法合成平均尺寸为14纳米的单层硫化钨纳米片，利用低温共焦显微镜和汉布里-布朗-特威斯装置进行单粒子光谱与光子关联测量。
approach.en: Wet-chemical synthesis of monolayer tungsten disulfide nanosheets with an average size of 14 nm, followed by single-particle spectroscopy and photon correlation measurements using cryogenic confocal microscopy.

main_takeaway.zh: 胶体硫化钨纳米片在5 K时表现出高达93%的单光子纯度（二阶关联函数值极低），且在高达110 K时仍能维持抗聚束效应，无需任何后处理。
main_takeaway.en: Colloidal tungsten disulfide nanosheets show a high single photon purity of 93% at 5 K (with very low second-order correlation) and maintain antibunching up to 110 K without any post-processing.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为基于溶液法制备确定性量子光源开辟了新途径，克服了传统量子点体系中常见的闪烁和发射周期长等缺点。
why_it_matters.en: This work opens new routes for solution-processed deterministic quantum light sources, overcoming common drawbacks of conventional quantum dot systems such as blinking and long emission cycles.

reason.zh: 首次在湿化学合成的二维半导体纳米片中实现了高纯度、无图案化的确定性单光子发射。
reason.en: It demonstrates high-purity, unpatterned deterministic single photon emission in wet-chemically synthesized 2D semiconductor nanosheets for the first time.

reason.zh: 论文结合了纳米材料合成与先进的光学量子测量，高度契合该期刊的纳米光子学和量子材料定位。
reason.en: The paper combines nanomaterial synthesis with advanced optical quantum measurements, fitting the journal's focus on nanophotonics and quantum materials.
